text:
Sam (AE): Hey team — Pollen Labs is asking for startup credits / promo to run a 6-week POC. They want to evaluate embeddings + chat for search+assist. Rough usage: ~100k tokens/day peak, ~10 qps, model family: open 13B. Any fast path for credits or a short-term discounted rate? :pray:
Maria (SE): Quick q — is this hosted Redwood API only or private deploy? Also do they need streaming? Can you paste expected prompt lengths?
Sam (AE): Hosted only for now. Mostly short queries (avg 120 tokens) with some 2048-context for multi-turn. No PHI. customer says conversion intent if POC looks good (target: $80k ARR year1).
Maria (SE): Ok good. If we run quantized 13B + batching we can hit cost target. Example config they plan:
```
model: redwood-13b-q4
seq_len: 2048
qps: 10-12
cache: enabled
```
Jordan (Sales Ops): Do they qualify for the Startup Program or is this a custom promo? Need VC/backer info + company age + monthly active users. If they meet criteria we can grant standard credits.
Sam (AE): They're backed by EmberVC, 18 months old, ~12 engineers. I attached the investor email in the deal doc.
Nina (Deal Desk): Looping in. Two paths: (1) Standard startup credits (automated) — requires VC confirmation + signup flow. (2) Custom promo/credits for POC — needs Deal Desk approval, justification, and finance sign-off. Provide expected convert timeline and estimate of committed spend if successful.
Ben (Finance): Heads-up — we prefer credits tied to a convert window or capped monthly amount. We need billing account on file and a max monthly cap (suggested $3k/mo) for credits to avoid open-ended exposure.
Asha (Security): Quick check — will POC ingest customer data that falls under regs? Any PHI/PCI? If yes, we need to ensure no long-term logs and explicit retention rules. Otherwise hosted is fine but add NDA for data handling.
Sam (AE): No PHI. They will use synthetic data snippets for training. They need a fast decision — POC kickoff targeted next week.
Dealbot: New deal request submitted to Deal Desk (#DD-8342) by Sam (AE). Automated check: startup program eligibility pending.
Nina (Deal Desk): Proposal: approve $3k in free credits for the 6-week POC + option for a one-time 20% discount on committed first-year invoice if they sign within 45 days of POC end. Conditions: VC proof, billing account on file, and completion of quick security checklist. I'll post an approval doc link. :white_check_mark:
Jordan (Sales Ops): If Nina signs off we can fast-track via the AE contract template. Sam — please add the VC email + the projected $80k ARR estimate to the deal record and tag me.
Sam (AE): Adding docs now. Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. If dealdesk approves today I can lock kickoff for next Wed. :rocket:
Nina (Deal Desk): Marking as approved provisionally. I'll convert to final once finance confirms cap and security checklist is green.
Ben (Finance): Confirmed the $3k cap and the 20% conversion discount as conditional. Finance will require the billing account and playbook entry.
Asha (Security): Once the checklist is filled (2-3 questions) we clear security. I can review ASAP.
Maria (SE): I'll prepare a minimal POC manifest and a cost/runbook so they don't blow through credits. Will share in the thread. :mag_right:
Sam (AE): Perfect — I'll update the timeline and send calendar invite once docs are finalized. Thanks everyone.
